concerns.text: Task T012 (Partitioning) and T013 (Metadata) are marked [P] (parallel-safe) but depend on T011 (Download) completing to produce `data/raw/femnist.parquet`. T011 is not marked as a strict prerequisite in the parallel block, and T012/T013 cannot execute without the raw data artifact. This violates the 'Producer before consumer' rule.

Task T018b (Orchestration loop) depends on T018 (FedAvg orchestrator), but T018 is marked [P] (parallel-safe) alongside T017. T018b cannot run until T018 is implemented. The [P] tag on T018 is misleading if it implies it can run in parallel with T018b or if the block implies T018b can start before T018 is done. T018b must strictly follow T018.

Task T026 (Plotting) is listed as dependent on T025, but T028 (Summary CSV) is listed as dependent on T024a/T024b/T025. However, T028's description states it must execute T027a, T035, T024a, T024b, T025 successfully. The ordering of T026 relative to T028 is ambiguous; if T028 is the final report, T026 (plot generation) should logically precede T028 if the report includes the plot, or be independent. The current text implies T028 depends on T026's output (the plot) for the 'Results' section, but the dependency list does not explicitly link T028 -> T026.

Task T011 is marked [P] but has a completion criterion dependent on file existence (`data/raw/femnist.parquet`). While T011 produces this, the [P] tag suggests it can run in parallel with other tasks. If T011 is the *only* producer of this file, it must complete before T012/T013. The [P] tag is technically correct for T011 itself (it has no dependencies), but the grouping implies T012/T013 can also run in parallel with T011, which is false. The grouping needs clarification to show T011 -> T012/T013 sequence.
